skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and characteristics of agricultural economics, basic theories, markets, international trade, and sustainable development in agriculture.
Apply knowledge and skills in analyzing agricultural markets and resource development.
Develop and solve specific problems related to agricultural economics, rural areas, and farmers through information gathering and planning.
Analyze and evaluate agricultural market theories and resource management issues.
Work effectively in teams to develop and present projects related to agricultural economics.
Demonstrate the ability to independently learn and accumulate experience to enhance professional expertise.
Show discipline and responsibility in class and group activities.
